data.body: Frozen real-store rehearsal failed closed before manifest output on . Root cause proven: the manifest fixture modeled recurrent snapshots incorrectly. Production recurrence carries cumulative  and  from the prior SNAPSHOT, but  and  describe only raw events folded in the current pass; bug privileged-nephelite-colt (aea0-0dac-b501-464c) explicitly established that a prior SNAPSHOT is absorbed through compiled_state and is not a successor source. Across the three incident tickets, 64 affected snapshots contain 1,257 directly folded target-comment representations (source+ledger present) and 8,880 inherited representations (source+ledger absent); every comment byte/object matches its source event and all 10,137 rows obey the expected direct-vs-inherited provenance relation, with zero anomalous rows. The current oracle rejects the 8,880 valid inherited rows. Targeted correction: make the fixture use batch-local provenance, continue requiring exact comment equality, require ledger membership iff a signed target is directly cited by source_event_uuids, remove only actually present source/ledger rows, and decrement cumulative authorship for every removed compiled comment. Then rerun the immutable manifest and full frozen rehearsal. No Jira DELETE, workflow change, remote ref update, or candidate publication occurred.
